snippet.title: Robomaze 3 gameplay (PC Game, 1991)
snippet.description:
Introduction and gameplay for Robomaze 3, Dos PC game produced by Wetware in 1991 - http://www.squakenet.com/download/robomaze-iii/8104/
Robo Maze 3 is a beautiful game like adventure, puzzle game. In this game you have to pass different levels using a jack.
Played through Dosbox emulation platform.
Recorded with original sound.

Similar videos you may like:
